summary: Receives RGB, mono, depth, or XYZ point-cloud image streams from an OAK Device CHOP and outputs the selected buffer as a TOP.

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: OAK Device CHOP running the pipeline.

key_params.name: outputindex
key_params.note: Output frame or buffer index; negative values can align latency.

key_params.name: outputindexunit
key_params.note: Units for output index: indices, frames, or seconds.

key_params.name: outputformat
key_params.note: Output pixel format, including pointcloud when supported.

common_gotchas: Requires a configured OAK Device CHOP and matching stream name.
Cache size of 2 is documented as a good async default.
Negative output indexes can delay images to align them with higher-latency tracking data.
Point-cloud output depends on depth stream names containing depth.
Output formats differ by stream type, so downstream TOPs should not assume RGBA8 data.
key_concepts: Receives selected OAK camera streams from an OAK Device CHOP.
Can output RGB, mono, depth, or XYZ point-cloud buffers depending on stream availability.
Cache Size and Output Index support asynchronous device-frame alignment.
Point-cloud conversion depends on depth stream naming and output-format choices.
